question: India’s First AI-powered, end-to-end digital Lok Adalat was launched in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Legal Services Authority (NALSA)** Chairman **Uday Umesh Lalit** launched India's first AI-powered, end-to-end digital Lok Adalat in Rajasthan.
 
• The** digitalisation of Lok Adalat** will facilitate common people to get justice from the comforts of their **homes**.
 
• Aligning with Lok Adalat’s vision to provide access to justice for all, Justice has developed the AI-powered Digital Lok Adalat to make its services more accessible, affordable, cost-effective, transparent, accountable, equitable, and secure. 
 
• Jupitice’s Digital Lok Adalat will be used by **Maharashtra **and **Rajasthan **to dispose of pending disputes/disputes at the pre-litigation stages quickly and efficiently
